title: Alive+
description: Trees now make sounds and shed leaf particles as they grow
body:
This data pack brings the game to life without complex mechanics.
- When a tree(of any type)mushroom/fungus grows, it play a sound (block.dreid_ghast.break).
- At the same time, leaf particles (tinted_leaves) appear around the tree. Two types of particles (mycelium and wax_off) appear around the mushrooms. Two types of particles also appear around the fungi (tinted_leaves (of the corresponding color) and crimson/warped spores).
- Your sapling also has a 0.1% chance of withering. 
- Trees grown by the player also have flowers or dry leaves, depending on the tree type.
